closingKeyword.why: The PR delivers everything the issue asks for: one dossier that assembles coverage tiers, guardian findings, sweep results and escape history. The 'signed report' is a content-hash digest, as the human answered, and verify recomputes it. The PR also answers the ideation objection by gating a real checklist item through the exit code (0 complete / 1 incomplete / 3 abstained) and by deriving a Worth-your-eyes list, and every section names what was dark. Batwoman closure audits were never in the issue's list; they are a follow-up, not a deferred acceptance item.

assumptions: Brainstorming sign-off was taken autonomously (fleet lane default). The spec's approaches and decisions D1-D9 were self-answered with the recommended option; the human answered only the digest fork beforehand.

D1: the exit code grades evidence completeness (0 complete, 1 any undeclared dark section, 3 nothing read). Worth-your-eyes items never move it, because the dossier grades the evidence and not the product.

D2: a section that does not apply is declared with --exclude id=reason and printed. Amendment A1 after review: excluding a section whose source WAS read is a usage error, so exclusion cannot hide findings.

D3: inputs are read from the paths the producers already write (history-v2.jsonl, .harness/analyses/canary-pr-guardian-*.json, .canary/quarantine.json). The sweep has no convention, so it requires --sweep.

D4: canary holds no incident data (STRATEGY.md Key metrics), so escape history comes from a hand-kept .canary/escapes.json. It is DARK without a parseable tracked_since date, the denominator that separates 'none escaped' from 'nobody counted'.

D5: digest = sha256 over canonical JSON (keys sorted at every depth), excluding generatedAt and the digest itself. Source paths are stored root-relative so a digest reproduces across checkouts (A2), and verify also recomputes counts and verdict (A3). The docs say it detects edits and is not proof of authorship.

D6/D7: the CLI is mounted through the readiness domain registry. The engine is in ts/src/analysis/manhunter/ with no guardian import: guardian records are parsed as a file contract. The CLI is in ts/src/manhunter/manhunter-cli.ts, following the rewind precedent. Nothing under ts/src/history/** changed (#1074).
D8: coverage tiers and guardian findings are two sections sharing one loader, mirroring the issue's wording.

canary-signal (#609, now merged) readers were NOT reused. They are self-contained .mjs skill runtime and cannot be imported from the TS engine. The TS engine reads the history store through NdjsonHistoryStore, the canonical reader, and the katana ledger with a small local parser that mirrors CAUSES_REQUIRING_ISSUE. Nothing was shared with #610 canary-clocktower.

Quarantine denominator is 'katana ran': katana writes a schema_version 2 ledger on every non --no-write scan, including an empty one (canary-katana scripts/cli.mjs), so a zero-row v2 ledger is fed (A5).
ci-readiness always reads the default history store, as canary ci-ready does, never --history. A store ci-ready would fail on makes that section DARK (A6).

Arch: module-size grew by the feature (46291 -> 47996). An allowance file was added, and the floor in baselines.json was refreshed with scripts/refresh-arch-baseline.mjs, because ts/test/arch-baseline-freshness.test.ts requires the floor to track the highest allowance. violationIds were untouched.

The worktree was relocated from canary-fleet-611-manhunter to canary-fleet-611-manhunter-2 after the human deleted the original directory to free disk space. The stale worktree entry was left alone as instructed.

acceptance.one-dossier: canary manhunter emits one markdown (and --json-out JSON) dossier covering run history, coverage tiers, guardian findings, ci-readiness, quarantine, sweep and escape history.
acceptance.abstains-loudly: Every section is FED only on a real read with a non-zero denominator. Missing, unreadable, malformed, self-abstained and zero-denominator sources are DARK with the reason, and dark sections head Worth your eyes. A dossier with a dark section never exits 0.
acceptance.gates-something: The exit code is the release-checklist item 'quality evidence is complete' (0/1/3; 2 usage).
acceptance.signed: A sha256 content digest over the canonical payload; canary manhunter verify recomputes it and checks verdict consistency.
acceptance.emit-only: No network, no posting; writes stdout or the --out/--json-out paths only.
